finding.classification: Historical q1883, conditional representable identity mismatch; producer namespace reachability open
finding.trace: MapLink::href encodes only the bare settlement or case-site component in a single destination query key. The caller retains query.destination as raw String and chooses the first TravelDestination with that ID. The producer separately compares the same string to each settlement and case-site ID, while StrategicPlaceId preserves their kinds. If both visible kinds share a component, both markers become selected, and MapOverlay rejects DuplicateSelection; the map host renders an unavailable state.
finding.conditions_and_limits: Requires an admitted geographic settlement and observer-owned exact case site with the same raw component, both present in the map input. The identity constructors accept the same valid component syntax but actual production ID namespaces and occurrence are unproven. No runtime witness, generated fixture, or claim of actual collision was made.
finding.historical_relationship: Exact related historical q1883 Q-L12-c04c89e00b6a45fa94d0 records the conditional untagged destination/same-component question. This assessment adds current caller and DuplicateSelection evidence; preserve historical author and no new accepted count.
finding.future_repair_direction: Determine whether cross-kind values can coincide in legitimate source data. If so, carry a canonical tagged place identity through URL selection, route lookup and map selection, with explicit native encoding at the adapter.
finding.later_acceptance_criteria: Distinct admitted settlement and case-site identities select one intended marker and corresponding destination even when their components coincide; observer and route authorization, escaped links and safe unavailable handling remain intact.

finding.classification: Conditional aggregate contract and cache precision question
finding.trace: The map producer accepts selected marker and RoutePlan separately, converts each point to checked WGS84 microdegrees and validates only route point count through MapRoute::new. The template obtains a route by matching a raw destination ID, while the terrain route cache uses E5-rounded start/goal coordinates and returns an existing plan on a key hit. No endpoint-to-selected-marker proof is performed by the map overlay.
finding.conditions_and_limits: Two differing inputs must map to one cache key or an inconsistent RoutePlan must otherwise be supplied; whether the resulting approximation is acceptable and what endpoint precision belongs to presentation versus strategic authority are unresolved. Native planner output, real data, timing and resulting route were not executed.
finding.historical_relationship: Adjacent to existing q194 ADLER-L11-TERRAIN-CACHE-ADMISSION-PARITY, which concerns validation before cache hit, but endpoint accuracy is not automatically the same defect. Prior /root/rig_identity map-route WEB-MAP-01/02/03 have separate clipping, provenance and work-bound scopes.
finding.future_repair_direction: Define accepted route-to-marker association and quantization error policy, then retain route identity/endpoints through producer and cache as needed without unilaterally changing native source precision.
finding.later_acceptance_criteria: A displayed computed route corresponds to the intended current origin and selected place under a documented precision contract; an unrelated/malformed route cannot silently masquerade as that selection.

finding.classification: Source-established conversion-policy difference; cross-owner consequence open
finding.trace: Map case-site admission validates E7, converts to degree floats, then rounds to checked microdegrees. The existing from_e7 path divides signed E7 components by ten, truncating toward zero. For example, an E7 component of -9 produces -1 by degree-to-microdegree rounding but 0 by truncating conversion. A distinct authoritative travel weather path uses from_e7 before weather cell selection.
finding.conditions_and_limits: The example is exact source-level arithmetic, not a generated or executed fixture. Consumer meanings differ and a changed map pin does not by itself prove incorrect weather or identity; whether unified rounding is required remains open. A 1-microdegree difference can matter only where an applicable downstream boundary/policy makes it meaningful.
finding.historical_relationship: Related to q133 travel geographic admission and q1564 regional geographic/coordinate consumer scope; no exact alias or current defect is asserted. Prior map-route agent separately read coordinates at 95e for roles 2364–2368; that earlier support remains theirs.
finding.future_repair_direction: Document and reconcile rounding versus truncation at the actual coordinate owners only if cross-consumer equivalence is required; retain intentional numerical and wire-boundary semantics.
finding.later_acceptance_criteria: Equivalent inputs obey the chosen documented conversion policy at each real consumer, with signed near-zero and cell-boundary behavior explicitly accounted for.

finding.classification: new current conditional source finding; aliases and central repair ownership unresolved
finding.title: Loot-to-target uses one party row instead of all same-item rows
finding.trace: The interface key describes Target as the quantity to retain or acquire in this inventory. The quest route loads party inventory rows and the party leader scoped targets; the template maps each loot item to the first same-item party row and puts only that quantity in data-current. The target-mode handler calculates target minus this one row and staged quantity. Stable physical objects can be represented as multiple quantity-1 rows with the same item ID. For example, if the party already holds two separate same-item rows of quantity 1 and the target is 2, the template supplies current=1 and the target-mode calculation can stage one more from a nonempty corresponding loot row, although the total of those party rows is already 2. This is arithmetic from source, not a run or simulated fixture.
finding.conditions: Requires this target to mean aggregate item quantity across the relevant party rows, qualifying stable objects and a same-item available loot row, and selection of target mode. Whether nested/conditioned items count in the intended target and the actual reachability, frequency, browser behavior and successful authoritative transfer remain unverified. The normal battle drop producer inspected at inventory_trade.rs:1361–1396 combines dropped quantities by item_id; duplicate loot-row staging is not asserted as reachable. Currency/alcohol/food grouping uses separate component controls in inventory-browser.js:218–299,302–350,380–444 and must be preserved; no blanket grouping claim.
finding.future_repair_direction: Reconcile the target owner and intended inclusion of physical, nested and measured objects, then compute the relevant aggregate safely and consistently with drafts and transfer admission. Preserve per-object identity, player choice, zero target behavior, and authoritatively validated transfers; any later verification waits for authorization.
relationships: Adler 059 READ-L11-390 explicitly left actual loot DOM staging/native quantity and target-owner filtering pending. 059 q188 ADLER-L11-LOOT-PAIR-ADMISSION and q629 Q-L11-9ee5b5fc5bde0e9c4315 concern pair/empty-token admission, a distinct first cut until centrally reconciled. 059 q546 Q-L11-a822e43c64bf770b3e99 concerns target-save acknowledgment, not automatically this arithmetic. 774 RIG-PPS-038 /fresh_current_source_reads/3 reports a historical full quest source read; new assessment is not a retroactive historical finding.

finding.classification: Conditional source-level mismatch; policy question
finding.trace: The sheet converts the effective character-or-location religion string through OfficialReligion::from_id and the summary invokes the skill icon producer with that context. The producer chooses the contextual official religion ahead of strongest knowledge, but decides to emit a religion badge if any official religion clears the rank threshold; it labels and ranks the badge using the chosen contextual religion. A below-threshold contextual religion and another above-threshold religion therefore give a below-threshold labeled badge, with qualifying religions listed in its tooltip.
finding.conditions_and_limits: The rank combination and context must be admitted by real producers. The meaning intended for the badge and whether context should dominate threshold are not settled. The conclusion follows from source conditions; no product run or synthetic fixture was performed.
finding.historical_relationship: Related to q2454 L2-CHARACTER-FAITH-TRAINING-OWNER-POLICY but distinct from automatically narrowing general faith to OfficialReligion. Nonofficial western_church/old_faith and unknown identities are intentionally recognized in display and must not be invalidated by this report. Central owns any alias decision.
finding.future_repair_direction: Decide whether the badge names the contextual faith or qualifying knowledge and align the admission predicate, label, rank and tooltip under that policy; retain distinct broad affiliation and official study semantics.
finding.later_acceptance_criteria: A below-threshold contextual faith with a different qualifying faith receives an intentional, accurately named/ranked summary; broader nonofficial affiliations and no-context cases remain supported.

central_decisions: Three /root/hair_ops reports displayed one complete equal body per role without recording the revision copy, not two separately attributed revision reads. The other six packets record separate 6533 and 95e displays. Existing bounded observations for roles2381,2389 and2395 remain linked unchanged.

Ordinary surgery omits both context claim and revision and the owner rejects a missing claim when qualifying membership exists. The separately traced quest Bandage action carries both; do not claim that all contextual care fails or a permission bypass occurred.

The rest charge comparison is conditional on successful clipping across a cost boundary; native settlement uses actual elapsed time while the summary derives board cost from requested time. Its missing observation, net-versus-gross, URL-location and historical clock causes retain separate owner questions.

q191 capability, q192 date projection, q517 residence clock and q510 shared query-error discard remain distinct. Camp forecast inputs, missing road challenge, recruitment collection and presence schedule are conditional receiver effects, not interchangeable queries.

The forage neighbor failure defaults a failed or absent sample to nonwater before an attested habitat decision; center error q518/q519 and q1878 pending policy remain distinct. q520–526 preserve their original terrain planner error stages.

A shared case lead can produce owner-keyed duplicate site pins while the inspected site-only query expects at most one; q1881 remains partial, owner visibility and SQL projection conditions open. The query envelope and reducer-code provenance questions require actual remote contracts, not assumed classifier defects.

A bestiary interpretation of 1000–1024 bytes can exceed the web limit after the 25-byte prefix; q539 malformed JSON is a different first failure. Lost anonymous-session response is conditional and distinct from entropy, pre-epoch time and key type.

For map q1883, matching raw place IDs select two markers and yield DuplicateSelection/unavailable rather than an arbitrary accepted route. E7 quantization and endpoint binding have distinct owners and no observed mismatch.

Loot target uses one matching party row; current source shows separately admitted quantity-one physical rows, but no duplicate-loot-row staging claim. The unaffiliated two-None party offer was already explicitly flagged in Adler391 and Lens12-802; it is not a newly invented historical finding.

q179 observer chronology, q193 medication-history availability, q197 missing limb availability, q187 cancellation and q2454 broad faith identity remain distinct. The faith badge threshold question is related but does not collapse the broader historical owner policy.

Each packet’s thirteen perspectives are bounded to that source family. The original 3821 ledger/queue remain missing, 059 history keeps its original authors and revision, and neither a repository-wide lens closure nor any implementation or product validation is asserted.
open: Actual producer populations, transport semantics, availability policy, location/observer chronology, identity ownership and exact aliases remain open.
